Date of service: 07/18/2025 | Dr. Felix Draycott, DO

Reason for consultation:
Low back pain with right leg symptoms, referred by Dr. Teodor Penrose, MD.

Review of systems:
Red flag screen negative: denies bowel or bladder dysfunction, saddle anesthesia, fever, unexplained weight loss, or history of cancer.

Physical exam:
Back: tenderness over the lower lumbar paraspinal muscles; straight-leg raise positive on the right at 30 degrees.
Neuro: strength 4/5 in right plantar flexion, right Achilles reflex 1+, decreased light touch over the lateral right foot.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: right S1 lumbar radiculopathy.
Plan: MRI lumbar spine without contrast to evaluate for disc herniation; home exercise program; follow up after imaging.
